name: Best Private Label Supplements for Gut Health

body.content:
Gut health supplements are some of the most sought-after products on the market today. While the popularity of gut health supplements may make purchasing decisions more complicated for consumers facing digestive health issues, your private label business has an opportunity to help them find relief.

Private labeling high-quality gut health formulas is a major win for both your business and your customers’ quality of life. With so many products on the market, you’ll want to hone in on supplements that are uniquely formulated to support the gut for specific health issues on the rise.

why have gut health supplements become so popular?

Gut discomforts aren’t anything new, but they have become more prevalent in recent years for several reasons.

Stress levels are at an all-time high, which has a massive impact on gut health. Studies show that ongoing high stress levels impact gut motility, gastric secretion, mucosal permeability and barrier function, and mucosal blood flow. Stress could even change the composition of the gut microbiota itself.[1]

Other factors that contribute to poor gut health include the overuse of antibiotics or NSAIDs, a current diet or diet history of ultra processed foods, blood sugar imbalance, or a gut pathogen such as a parasite, fungal overgrowth, or bacteria.

These realities have led many people to seek professional-grade gut health formulas to better support discomforts like excessive gas, bloating, occasional diarrhea, and even anxiousness, trouble sleeping, and mood imbalances. Adding products that address these issues to your private label brand can significantly help grow your business and improve your customers’ lives—but choosing the correct formulas is critical.

five trending gut health supplements for private labeling

The following formulas are unique in how they target modern-day gut challenges and have been highly successful with Praxera' private label clients.

enzyme benefits™

Discomfort in the upper GI tract after eating can sometimes point to insufficient digestive enzymes and stomach acid. Enzymes are protein-based compounds that function as catalysts to initiate and regulate certain critical parts of the digestive process. This formula offers a broad range of enzymes, including:

  • Amylase: breaks down carbohydrates.
  • Lipase: breaks down fats.
  • Proteases (such as Trypsin and Pepsin): breaks down proteins.
  • Cellulase: breaks down fiber.
  • Glucoamylase: breaks down maltose.
  • Invertase: breaks down sucrose.
  • Peptidase: breaks down casein and gluten.
  • Alpha-galactosidase: breaks down carbohydrates in legumes.
  • Xylanase: breaks down plant fibers.
  • Pectinase: breaks down pectin found in fruits.

mega probiotics™ with digestive enzymes (chewable)

This product has been hugely successful for those looking to take fewer supplements and who prefer not to or can’t swallow pills. Probiotics are another best seller for gut health supplements and, when combined with digestive enzymes, offer comprehensive GI support.* Mega Probiotics™ with Digestive Enzymes provides 2.5 billion CFU per tablet of non-dairy probiotic cultures and a broad range of proprietary enzymes that specifically target the breakdown of milk sugar and dairy products.

gi benefits™

GI Benefits is a trending private label supplement that supports GI health and intestinal repair.* Specifically, it works to strengthen and repair the gut lining, promote regular bowel movements, and normalize levels of beneficial gut bacteria.* Many practitioners and private label entrepreneurs alike have found staggering results with GI Benefits for soothing and relief of occasional digestive discomforts and immune support.*

mega probiotics™ nd

There are seemingly endless probiotic supplements on the market, but the truly effective ones are limited. Offering a probiotic in your private label practice that is broad-spectrum and high in CFUs is what will set your product apart. Mega Probiotics™ ND  is a non-dairy probiotic formula that provides 52.5 billion CFU per capsule and nine probiotic strains, including lactobacilli, bifidobacteria, streptococcus thermophilus, and fructooligosaccharides (FOS) as a prebiotic.

candid-away™

Fungal overgrowths are commonplace complaints that can be worsened by stress, a high-sugar diet, antibiotics, steroids, cortisone drugs, chlorinated water, and birth control pills. Along with dietary changes, a targeted product for yeast overgrowth can hugely support microflora balance.

Candid-Away™ is a formula designed to support digestive tract detoxification to maintain a healthy balance of intestinal microflora.* It combines a unique mixture of olive leaf extract to support immune system function, calcium caprylate and grapefruit seed extract to maintain a healthy balance of intestinal microflora, berberine to inhibit the growth of harmful yeast, bacteria and protozoa, betaine HCl for acid balance in the stomach, and fiber-digesting enzymes (cellulase and hemicellulase) to balance good and bad microflora and digest candida.*

items.answer: Digestive complaints are common, and awareness of the gut's role in overall wellness has grown considerably. That combination keeps demand high and makes gut health a reliable category for a private label line.
items.question: Why are gut health supplements so popular?

items.answer: Probiotics, digestive enzymes, and broader digestive support formulas are the usual core. Offering both capsule and chewable options widens the range of customers you can serve.
items.question: Which gut health products work well for private labeling?

items.answer: Look at the strains included, the CFU count, and whether the product requires refrigeration, since storage affects how you stock and ship it. Formulas combining probiotics with digestive enzymes suit customers who would rather buy one product than two.
